pr_title: More concise Arel `Or` ast and make `Or` visitor non recursive
pr_body:
Before this, 1000 `Or` nodes will raise "stack level too deep" due to
visiting too deep Arel ast.

This makes more concise Arel `Or` ast and `Or` visitor non recursive if
`Or` nodes are adjoined, as a result, "stack level too deep" is no
longer raised.

```ruby
class Post < ActiveRecord::Base
end

posts = (0..500).map { |i| Post.where(id: i) }

Benchmark.ips do |x|
  x.report("inject scopes") { posts.inject(&:or).to_sql }
end
```

Before:

```
Warming up --------------------------------------
      where with ids     9.000  i/100ms
Calculating -------------------------------------
      where with ids     96.126  (± 2.1%) i/s -    486.000  in   5.058960s
```

After:

```
Warming up --------------------------------------
       inject scopes    10.000  i/100ms
Calculating -------------------------------------
       inject scopes    101.714  (± 2.9%) i/s -    510.000  in   5.018880s
```

Fixes #39032.

issue_context.title: "Stack level too deep" when `inject`ing a lot of activerecord relations via `#or`
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce
execute a file in the following gist https://gist.github.com/trushkevich/9d8cdc3c7466e7bc793ae7075534db4f
```ruby
ruby inject_or_stack_level_too_deep.rb
```
### Expected behavior
`test_ok` passes
`test_parser_stack_overflow` passes
`test_stack_level_too_deep` passes

### Actual behavior
`test_ok` passes
`test_parser_stack_overflow` fails
`test_stack_level_too_deep` fails

### System configuration
**Rails version**:
5.2.3, 6.1.0.alpha

**Ruby version**:
2.4.1, 2.6.3

review_comments: This is a safe transformation because of the fact that SQL `OR` has lower precedence than `AND`, yes?
